title: SKU eligibility checker and launch synergy plan for Dedicated Capacity
creator: Marco Benitez
description: Goal: build a lightweight SKU eligibility checker and a coordinated GTM play that ensures accounts, partners, and billing are ready for new dedicated capacity SKUs (region + instance family + reservation plan) before marketing/partner comms. This ticket covers the PM orchestration, a simple eligibility API/CSV extractor for sales/partners, release notes coordination, and a short runbook for exceptions. Outcome: zero-to-minimal failed activations on Day 1 and a single source of truth for which customers are eligible for reservations and SKU swaps.
acceptance_criteria: Eligibility query can produce a customer-level CSV with SKU-compatibility flags (region, instance_family, billing_currency, contract_qualifies)
Sales/Partner team sign-off on format and cadence for eligibility exports
Billing confirms mapping for new SKUs and has migration instructions for existing commitments
Release notes include an "eligibility and activation" section and are approved by Legal and Support
Runbook for common failure modes (quota, network/VPC config, KMS missing) is published to Confluence
milestones: 2026-02-25: Initial data model and fields agreed with Billing and Sales Ops
2026-03-04: Prototype CSV exporter + sample for 50 customers produced
2026-03-10: Internal GTM review (Sales, Support, Billing, Legal) - feedback captured
2026-03-20: Final eligibility schema and release notes draft ready
2026-03-28: Dry-run activation for pilot customers; runbook validated
rollout_steps: 1) Freeze final SKU mapping with Billing (region -> instance family -> sku_id)
2) Run eligibility exporter for active customers and produce CSV with reason codes
3) Share CSV with Sales/Partners; provide a 3-day window for fix requests
4) Patch release notes and publish internal doc with activation runbook
5) Execute pilot activations for 10 pilot customers with Partner Ops oversight
6) After pilot success, schedule public launch and partner comms; monitor activations for 72 hours
notes: 2026-02-19: Kickoff with Billing — main trade-off is speed vs completeness of eligibility logic. We chose a conservative approach: include only checks we can validate from existing systems (billing currency, active contract, region entitlement).
2026-02-27: Engineering flagged data freshness issues for entitlements; workaround is to timestamp exports and include a 'stale_data' flag
2026-03-05: Sales asked for a confidence score column; agreed to add a simple heuristic (0-100) based on checks passed
2026-03-11: Legal requested language for release notes clarifying activation SLAs and customer responsibilities for network/VPC settings
Next steps: finalize mapping table, run pilot on 2026-03-24, and update release notes template with an "Activation prerequisites" section
